As this Part details, the Supreme Court has recognized that the Take Care Clause and the Oath Clause obligate Presidents to ensure that all enforcement actions comply with the Constitution’s mandates. Moreover, well-accepted doctrines, such as construing statutes to avoid constitutional problems and refusing to defend or enforce constitutionally problematic statutes, concede the propriety of the President engaging in such review.
